Application Data.NAME: Bright & Clean Laundry Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bright & Clean Laundry Services is a self-service laundromat located in Springfield, IL, providing a clean and convenient environment for customers to do their laundry. Our services include coin-operated washers and dryers, folding assistance, and vending machines for laundry supplies. We adhere to strict safety and environmental standards, ensuring minimal chemical use and regular maintenance of our equipment to prevent hazards. Our employees undergo routine safety training, and we maintain a clean safety record with no incidents reported. Our operations focus on customer satisfaction and efficient service, making us a trusted choice for laundry services in the community.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2023, a small fire occurred in the laundry room due to a malfunctioning dryer, causing damage to one drying unit. The fire was quickly contained, and no injuries were reported. The estimated repair cost is $4,500. The claim is currently under review with our insurance provider, and repairs are expected to be completed by September 30, 2023.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols during business hours and installation of a monitored alarm system.
